fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami-area economic conditions and rents, hotel receiverships and pricing, and municipal matters including election ballot numbering and Miami Beach bulkheading costs. Reports and opinion pieces address nursing work requirements promoted by the Dade County Medical Society, banking service charges on small accounts, and utility competition in the Redlands/Homestead area involving Florida Power & Light. Also includes a report on the inquest of Jessie Peterson, sports/boxing coverage and promotions, and assorted local notes, letters to the editor, and advertisements.
